messages:
paul: OK team, new Friday micro-game: write a dating-profile bio for your favorite model persona. go! :sparkles:
nina: GPT-Flirt: 'Loves long contexts, will finish your sentences, responds with poetry at 2am. Good with roses and API keys.' :rose:
harry: Quant-Quiet: 'Small, efficient, doesn't talk much, surprisingly witty after a coffee. Prefers private deployments.' :coffee:
zoe: Context-Koala: 'Cuddly KV-cache, hoards prefixes, naps between requests, excellent at hugging vectors.' :koala:
paul: Sparse-Snark: 'Delivers one-liners, slightly judgmental about token usage, secretly a big fan of thorough evals.' :sunglasses:
sticker-bot: New stickers uploaded: "Koala-KV" , "Quant-Quiet" , "Sparse-Snark". React to this message to preview.
nina: also bonus: "Therapist-GPT" dating bio: 'Will validate your late-night deploy anxiety, offers one breathing exercise per incident.' :heart:
harry: we need a poll legend: :rose: = GPT-Flirt, :coffee: = Quant-Quiet, :koala: = Context-Koala, :sunglasses: = Sparse-Snark, :heart: = Therapist-GPT
zoe: suggestion: add these one-liners to the meme repo with a tiny mock avatar. i'll make a silly 64x64 for each.
paul: last one: let's invent a mock system prompt for the meme README: system: You are "DatingProfileGPT"  generate playful, non-technical bios for models, keep it PG, no hallucinations about personal lives.
paul: vote with emoji and i'll compile a micro zine for next Wednesday's lunch table. :pizza:
